notes.title: Find Love or Die Trying PC Bugfix Patch - Oct 11 2021
notes.content:
- Various spelling and grammar fixes
- Allie no longer incorrectly shows in front of other characters on her third date

Thank you to everybody in the discord for helping me catch these errors!

The same fixes & previous performance improvements will be coming soon to Mac. I'm working as hard as I can on my own to get these fixes across both Windows and Mac!

tags.bug: - Allie no longer incorrectly shows in front of other characters on her third date

notes.title: Find Love or Die Trying Release Patch - Sept 18 2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*]- Changing your mind on who's your favorite soulmate candidate on Day 3 no longer soft locks the game
[*]- CPU Performance Issues due to unlocked frame rate no longer occurs, framerate is now limited by default
[*]- Name of non-favorite soulmate candidate no longer shows as empty at times
[*]- Various spelling and grammar fixes
[/list]
